No public npm packages under @blockpit scope or user ~blockpit (0 results).
No public PyPI packages under user blockpit.

No live secrets / credentials / API keys attributable to Blockpit were found in public GitHub via common env/config/cred dorks.
No GraphQL endpoint on any reachable API host (checked /graphql, /graphiql, /playground; main client bundles never mention 'graphql').

open_threads: GET /api/General/Version on both blockchain-api.blockpit.io and financial-api.blockpit.io - only op the spec declares as apiKey-free; probe first in next session to confirm server behavior matches spec + capture build/version string.

GET /api/Elrond/DeconstructTransaction and /api/Hedera/DeconstructTransaction - the spec declares NO 401 response. Test unauth; if 200 is returned, runtime apiKey enforcement is missing on these two chains and probably on /GetAccountBalances + /IsValidImportAccount on both.

GET /api/Bitcoin/GetTransactionsByXPubKey (+ Y/Z-Pub variants + Litecoin/Dash/Doge/BCH) - 34 xpub endpoints collectively de-anonymise wallets from a single extended public key. Test with any held apiKey for cross-user privacy impact.
GET /api/General/GetMultichainAddressesByAddressList - one call fans out to 66 chain RPCs with a bulk address list; the single most expensive op in the surface and a resource-abuse multiplier.

TaxToolEvmTransaction.kyt_txdb_id (int64) leaks internal transaction DB IDs through this unauthenticated utility API. Use observed kyt_txdb_id values as neighbor-id seeds against cn.blockpit.io / bit-api / cta-api /v1/transactions/{id} and /report/{id} endpoints in the authenticated session.

cn.blockpit.io/api/v1/transactions/export?year=<YYYY> is the SuPuL endpoint - confirmed real path but all requests from automation are 403-blocked at Cloudflare managed challenge before reaching the Blockpit origin. Need origin IP (TLS SAN / passive DNS / cert transparency) to probe auth-scheme error body; this is a hard-dependency for the whole cn.blockpit.io/api/* surface.

/v1/users PATCH is a mass-assignment candidate - login response contains advisorRole, agentId, advisorId fields - test whether sending these in a PATCH escalates a standard user to a gov advisor on cn.blockpit.io (needs authenticated session).

gov.blockpit.io POST /v1/members payload includes isAdmin passed straight through from client (createMember sends {name,email,password,isAdmin}). If server trusts isAdmin, self-registering a gov advisor + flipping isAdmin would give full tenant admin on gov-api.blockpit.io - needs a gov-tenant invite to test.

/v2/auth/handoff + /v2/auth/handoff/redeem + /v2/auth/magicLink/redeem + /v2/auth/sso/redeem are NOT behind Turnstile (per protectedEndpoints list in prod env config). Test one-time-use enforcement and token lifetime of handoff / magic-link flows (per Claude.md auth-token-lifecycle HV pattern).
/v1/payments/discount - discount/coupon endpoint per Claude.md HV pattern; test unauth listing and auth'd neighbor-code guessing.
/v3/balances AND /v2/balances AND /v1/balances all coexist - older versions commonly have weaker auth/scoping than the latest. Test v1 and v2 for IDOR after v3 is locked down.

report-id endpoints /report/{id}, /report/download/{id}, /report/result/{id}, /report/configuration/{id} on gate.blockpit.io/t take a predictable id (tax year + user). Highest-severity target per Claude.md 'predictable-id > everything else'. Needs own session first, then neighbor id probe.
/v1/sourceOfFunds/{id}/file?language=<lang> generates a PDF document per source-of-funds id. Predictable id, auth required; test neighbor id for cross-tenant SoF-document read.
/v1/transactions/{id}/editHistory + /v1/transactions/{id}/costBasis are per-transaction read endpoints taking an id in path. Predictable-id candidate - test neighbor id after login.
/v1/integrations/checkIfExists is an account-enumeration candidate - test whether POSTing {email, exchangeId} reveals whether a given email has an integration of a given type.
/v1/users/intercom/auth returns Intercom HMAC - if the HMAC is scoped only by email/userId and not combined with a tenant check, could allow Intercom chat impersonation.

blockchain-api.blockpit.io + financial-api.blockpit.io serve identical 1.1MB swagger spec UNAUTH at /swagger/v1/swagger.json. 641 endpoints across 66 chains, apiKey query-string auth, no RateLimit headers, Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. Test whether apiKey values are predictable, incremental, or whether a test/demo apiKey is handed out via register flow or shows in frontend.

api.blockpit.io is the OAuth2 token root per Angular env (authConfig.apiRoot). SPA ships clientId:7 + clientSecret:yne8cq00xogLg4LcIosYMcBkCWMPcF8cZaZfx15B. Host is currently 502-dark from our vantage - once reachable, map /oauth/token response for any info leak.

api-docs.cryptotax.io exposes a partner CryptoTax API v3 (requestReportCalculation, checkResult, assetsByTickers, transaction_types) accepting JWT bearer tokens; the vendor-hosted domain belongs to Blockpit. Test for predictable report IDs, cross-tenant read of /checkResult results, and v2 (EOL 2026-12-01) still being reachable without authorization checks.

app.blockpit.io login/dashboard flow is scraped headlessly by invoice-collector/invoice-collector with no CAPTCHA field - check if signup / login lacks CAPTCHA and if a usable session can be created without email verification (high-value attack pattern in Claude.md).

Angular + NX frontend architecture confirmed via marcellkiss/2022-04-27-nx-monorepo mirror - once logged in, enumerate the real app bundle for every `apps/*-app` and `libs/*/feature-*` route for GET-by-id endpoints (IDOR-prone pattern per Claude.md).

Docker Hub blockpit/web, blockpit/node, blockpit/php base images are public - pull and inspect for any build-time baked environment variables, bundled .env.*, embedded private keys, or leftover /app source left in the image after squash.

api-staging / cta-staging / tokensale-staging / blog-staging / cta-test / bit-api-test / api-test / blockpit-test / blockpit-new / cn2 / cn1-test / cn-test / cn2-test subdomains were all 502-dark on both attempts; prioritize revisiting these in a later session (may be VPN-gated internal-only).

Peter Schoellauf is confirmed Blockpit staff via @blockpit.io email in commit trailer - pivot through DAICers/DAIC Capital org for any ops dashboards or server configs leaking Blockpit infra details.

Hetzner buckets 'ct-unified-generated-reports' and 'ct-wiso-generated-reports' return NoSuchBucket in fsn1/nbg1/hel1 for every S3-compatible probe (ListObjects v1+v2, HEAD, ?location/?cors/?acl/?policy/?versioning/?lifecycle/?website/?encryption, presigned-URL-shaped GET, OPTIONS with blockpit origin). No listing, no CORS reflection, no finding against these names today. Next-session validation: live-auth agent must generate a tax PDF, capture GET /report/download/{id} on gate.blockpit.io, read the real downloadUrl host+bucket; those two names may be substring matches against a longer real bucket. See hetzner/BUCKETS.md.

Angular 'whitelistedDomainsCors' is mis-named - it is actually a BEARER-TOKEN-STRIP whitelist in the HTTP interceptor (String.includes substring match). URLs containing cdn.blockpit.io, ct-unified-generated-reports, ct-wiso-generated-reports, fsn1.your-objectstorage.com are issued WITHOUT the OAuth2 bearer. Substring match on user-controllable URLs (if any such input vector exists) is a minor hazard - revisit after mapping any user-URL-input feature in the authenticated app.

staging--bp-frontend-prod.netlify.app and staging--bp-gov-frontend-prod.netlify.app serve older Angular builds (2.17.1 and 2.60.5) UNAUTHED on production slugs - the staging-branch is excluded from Netlify's password scope on these prod slugs. Not a finding on its own (same env/secrets as prod, no sourcemap) but is an ongoing exposure channel: any time a developer deploys a staging-branch preview on a *-prod slug, it ships open to the internet. Low severity info-disclosure. Could become higher if a future staging build ever ships a new env/secret before prod gets the same code.

findings.summary: Dangling CNAME link.blockpit.io -> custom-domain.linkdrip.io (LinkDrip) with no claimed tenant - every slug 301s to vendor fallback https://fun.com. Attacker can sign up at LinkDrip and claim the subdomain, inheriting live traffic from Blockpit's X profile, Facebook, LinkedIn, iOS/Android app badges, and marketing campaign shortlinks for phishing. No main-app session-cookie reach (no Domain=.blockpit.io auth cookie), so phishing-only.

hetzner_object_storage.frontend_role: Angular 'whitelistedDomainsCors' array matches these strings via String.prototype.includes to STRIP the OAuth2 bearer before the HTTP interceptor sends the request - semantically a bearer-token-strip whitelist, not a CORS whitelist. On today's app the URL is only constructed from a backend-provided downloadUrl so there is no user-controllable path.
hetzner_object_storage.cdn_blockpit_io_note: cdn.blockpit.io is unrelated - CloudFront+AWS S3 (x-amz-server-side-encryption, x-amz-version-id, via 1.1 cloudfront.net), not Hetzner. Root is 403 AccessDenied (correct posture); images at /images/illustrations/* are public (expected).
hetzner_object_storage.verdict_now: no finding against these two bucket names - either deleted/renamed since bundle shipped or the strings are substring-matches against longer real bucket names. Live-auth agent must capture GET /report/download/{id} downloadUrl to identify real bucket name, then re-run probe matrix. Hypothetical worst-case if real bucket is public-listable with per-user tax PDFs: AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H ~9.0+ OWASP A01.

openapi_surface.notes: Specs are byte-identical in paths+definitions; only host differs. Swagger 2.0 (NSwag/.NET). All 641 operations are GET. 60 definitions. Zero securityDefinitions, zero per-op security. apiKey is a query-string param on 640/641 ops (enforced server-side via 401). The surface is a stateless blockchain-data gateway (66 chains x small catalog) - no user IDs, tenants, PII, admin, discount or auth-lifecycle endpoints.
key_findings_offline: /api/General/Version is the ONLY op the spec declares as apiKey-free. Confirms host reachability + exposes build version.
6 Elrond + Hedera ops declare NO 401 response (/DeconstructTransaction, /IsValidImportAccount, /GetAccountBalances on each chain). Suggests apiKey check may be absent at runtime on those two chains.
Hedera_IsValidImportAccount parameter doc uses the Elrond erd1 regex (copy-paste bug). If the backend handler is also copied, Hedera input validation is broken.

TaxToolEvmTransaction leaks internal integer IDs (kyt_txdb_id int64, kyt_contract_id int32, blockchain_id, currency_id). These are IDOR seeds for sibling cn.blockpit.io / bit-api endpoints that accept the same IDs.
34 xpub/ypub/zpub endpoints: a single apiKey + a single xpub de-anonymises an entire wallet across all derived addresses.
/api/General/GetMultichainAddressesByAddressList fans one call into 66 chain RPCs - the most expensive single operation. If apiKey-free, resource abuse at scale.
ResponseModelOfObject.result and TaxToolToken.details are free-form object fields (empty inline schema). Potential arbitrary-JSON injection channels from upstream RPCs.
Spec declares schemes:[http] on TLS-only hosts - spec-authoring drift, not a live hole.

netlify_surface.slug_discovery_method: DNS CNAME via Google DoH (raw/cname-doh.txt) - deterministic, no guessing needed
netlify_surface.lock_bypass_summary: 0/8 locked custom-domain hosts bypassed at slug level. Netlify enforces password at the <slug>.netlify.app layer as well (401 identical body, 8296B). Classic 'edge-only lock' misconfig does NOT apply to this account.
